hooks.command: f=$(python -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''))"); case "$f" in *.dart) dart format "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 ;; esac

f=$(python -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''))"); case "$f" in *.dart) out=$(dart analyze --no-fatal-warnings "$f" 2>&1); if printf '%s' "$out" | grep -qE '^[[:space:]]*error -'; then FPATH="$f" python -c "import json,os,sys; print(json.dumps({'decision':'block','reason':'dart analyze encontro errores en '+os.environ['FPATH']+':
'+sys.stdin.read()}))" <<< "$out"; fi ;; esac
